merkle_updates_paused.meaning: Merkle tree updates are paused because disputer != address(0)

dispute_amount_adjustable.meaning: Governor can successfully adjust disputeAmount parameter

assumptions: Governor is the authorized administrator attempting to adjust disputeAmount.
The dispute is active (disputer != address(0)) at the time of the governance adjustment attempt.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker must pay disputeAmount or hold tokens to call disputeTree, so the economic viability of the re-dispute cycle cannot be formalized.
Report does not specify whether resolveDispute(false) is permissionless or who may call it, affecting the liveness of the resolution path.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the governance_paralysis impact (inability to adjust disputeAmount); the separate reward_distributions_halted impact is not covered by this claim.
disputer_is_set is a grounded Boolean because the report states the disputer != address(0) condition without a numeric definition.
The indefinite-blocking aspect is represented as the failure of dispute_amount_adjustable under an active dispute; the temporal 'indefinitely' qualifier is not separately encoded.
